tools.name: wheelhouse_list_listings
tools.description: List the listings in your Wheelhouse portfolio with their id, channel, wheelhouse_id, title, market, currency and active state. Call this first: other tools need the id and channel values from here. RM API: GET /listings.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_listing
tools.description: Get one listing with its title, location, room and property type, preferences summary and market. RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_pricing_tier
tools.description: Get a listing's pricing tier and recommendation horizon (how many days ahead prices are recommended). RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/pricing_tier.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_listing_flags
tools.description: List the system flags on a listing: setups that stop Wheelhouse from pricing it as recommended, such as fixed prices or a minimum above the recommendation. RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/flags.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_recent_changes
tools.description: Get the times of the latest preference change (settings) and custom rate change (rates) on a listing. Cheap way to see whether anything moved. RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/recent_changes.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_listing_kpis
tools.description: Get rolling-window performance KPIs for a listing (occupancy, revenue, ADR and similar). basis: current (today) or stly (same time last year). RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/kpis.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_price_recommendations
tools.description: Get the daily recommended nightly prices for a listing over its recommendation horizon, with the min stay settings applied. RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/price_recommendations.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_price_calendar
tools.description: Get the price calendar of a listing: the price Wheelhouse has posted or would post for each stay date. Optional date range. RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/price_calendar.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_base_price_recommendation
tools.description: Get the base price recommendation options for a listing. RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/base_price_recommendation.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_min_max_prices
tools.description: Get the minimum and maximum price calendar of a listing (the price floor and ceiling per date). RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/min_max_prices.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_bulk_price_recommendations
tools.description: Get daily price recommendations for up to 10 listings in one call. All listings must share one channel (or pass "wheelhouse" with wheelhouse_ids). RM API: GET /bulk/price_recommendations.

tools.name: wheelhouse_list_price_models
tools.description: List the price models a customer can pick from, with their ids and names. RM API: GET /price_models.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_preferences
tools.description: Get the full set of pricing preferences for a listing: base price, minimum and maximum price, minimum stay, discounts, seasonality and more. RM API: GET /preferences/{listing_id}.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_preferences_changelog
tools.description: Get the history of changes to a listing's pricing preferences, optionally for a date range. RM API: GET /preferences/{listing_id}/changelog.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_custom_rates
tools.description: List the active and upcoming custom rates set on a listing (fixed prices or percent adjustments per date range). RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/custom_rates.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_reservations
tools.description: Get the reservations of a listing in a date range (guest stays, booking dates, revenue). RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/reservations.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_listing_notes
tools.description: List the notes on a listing (pricing reminders and comments), optionally for a date range. RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}/notes.

tools.name: wheelhouse_list_segments
tools.description: List the portfolio segments of your account (groups of listings you manage together). RM API: GET /segments.

tools.name: wheelhouse_list_dynamic_sets
tools.description: List dynamic sets (property groups with shared performance metrics), optionally by name or kind. RM API: GET /sets.

tools.name: wheelhouse_list_markets
tools.description: List the Wheelhouse markets in a country with their ids, names and postal codes. RM API: GET /market_report.

tools.name: wheelhouse_list_notifications
tools.description: List the active Wheelhouse notifications for your account (pricing alerts and warnings that need a look). RM API: GET /notifications.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_usage
tools.description: Get your RM API usage (request volume, error rates, response times) over the last few days. Cached by the API for a few minutes. RM API: GET /usage.

tools.name: wheelhouse_add_listing_note
tools.description: WRITE: create a note on a listing, optionally for a stay-date range and settings sections. Does not change prices. RM API: POST /listings/{listing_id}/notes.

tools.name: wheelhouse_sync_listing
tools.description: WRITE: trigger a manual sync of one listing with its channel. Safe to repeat. RM API: POST /listings/{listing_id}/sync.

tools.name: wheelhouse_set_custom_rate
tools.description: WRITE, CHANGES LIVE PRICES: set a custom rate for a listing over a date range. fixed = a nightly price per weekday (needs currency). adjustment = percent of the recommendation per weekday (100 = no change). Delete it with wheelhouse_delete_custom_rates. RM API: PUT /listings/{listing_id}/custom_rate

tools.name: wheelhouse_delete_custom_rates
tools.description: WRITE, CHANGES LIVE PRICES: delete the custom rates of a listing in a date range, so the recommendation applies again. RM API: DELETE /listings/{listing_id}/custom_rates.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wheelhouse_get_price_calendar, wheelhouse_get_listing_notes, wheelhouse_list_notifications · Public sink: wheelhouse_get_price_calendar, wheelhouse_get_bulk_price_recommendations, wheelhouse_add_listing_note, wheelhouse_sync_listing · Destructive: wheelhouse_set_custom_rate, wheelhouse_delete_custom_rates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wheelhouse_get_price_calendar, wheelhouse_get_listing_notes, wheelhouse_list_notifications · Public sink: wheelhouse_get_price_calendar, wheelhouse_get_bulk_price_recommendations, wheelhouse_add_listing_note, wheelhouse_sync_listing · Destructive: wheelhouse_set_custom_rate, wheelhouse_delete_custom_rates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
